kjv.31:1: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
kjv.31:2: Avenge the children of Israel of the Midianites: afterward shalt thou be gathered unto thy people.
kjv.31:3: And Moses spake unto the people, saying, Arm some of yourselves unto the war, and let them go against the Midianites, and avenge the LORD of Midian.
kjv.31:4: Of every tribe a thousand, throughout all the tribes of Israel, shall ye send to the war.
kjv.31:5: So there were delivered out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand of [every] tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.
kjv.31:6: And Moses sent them to the war, a thousand of [every] tribe, them and Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the holy instruments, and the trumpets to blow in his hand.
kjv.31:7: And they warred against the Midianites, as the LORD commanded Moses; and they slew all the males.
kjv.31:8: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; [namely], Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
kjv.31:9: And the children of Israel took [all] the women of Midian captives, and their little ones, and took the spoil of all their cattle, and all their flocks, and all their goods.
kjv.31:10: And they burnt all their cities wherein they dwelt, and all their goodly castles, with fire.
kjv.31:11: And they took all the spoil, and all the prey, [both] of men and of beasts.
kjv.31:12: And they brought the captives, and the prey, and the spoil, unto Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and unto the congregation of the children of Israel, unto the camp at the plains of Moab, which [are] by Jordan [near] Jericho.
kjv.31:13: And Moses, and Eleazar the priest, and all the princes of the congregation, went forth to meet them without the camp.
kjv.31:14: And Moses was wroth with the officers of the host, [with] the captains over thousands, and captains over hundreds, which came from the battle.
kjv.31:15: And Moses said unto them, Have ye saved all the women alive?
kjv.31:16: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and there was a plague among the congregation of the LORD.
kjv.31:17: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman that hath known man by lying with him.
kjv.31:18: But all the women children, that have not known a man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.
kjv.31:19: And do ye abide without the camp seven days: whosoever hath killed any person, and whosoever hath touched any slain, purify [both] yourselves and your captives on the third day, and on the seventh day.
kjv.31:20: And purify all [your] raiment, and all that is made of skins, and all work of goats' [hair], and all things made of wood.
kjv.31:21: And Eleazar the priest said unto the men of war which went to the battle, This [is] the ordinance of the law which the LORD commanded Moses;
kjv.31:22: Only the gold, and the silver, the brass, the iron, the tin, and the lead,
kjv.31:23: Every thing that may abide the fire, ye shall make [it] go through the fire, and it shall be clean: nevertheless it shall be purified with the water of separation: and all that abideth not the fire ye shall make go through the water.
kjv.31:24: And ye shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and ye shall be clean, and afterward ye shall come into the camp.
kjv.31:25: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
kjv.31:26: Take the sum of the prey that was taken, [both] of man and of beast, thou, and Eleazar the priest, and the chief fathers of the congregation:
kjv.31:27: And divide the prey into two parts; between them that took the war upon them, who went out to battle, and between all the congregation:
kjv.31:28: And levy a tribute unto the LORD of the men of war which went out to battle: one soul of five hundred, [both] of the persons, and of the beeves, and of the asses, and of the sheep:
kjv.31:29: Take [it] of their half, and give it unto Eleazar the priest, [for] an heave offering of the LORD.
kjv.31:30: And of the children of Israel's half, thou shalt take one portion of fifty, of the persons, of the beeves, of the asses, and of the flocks, of all manner of beasts, and give them unto the Levites, which keep the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD.
kjv.31:31: And Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.
kjv.31:32: And the booty, [being] the rest of the prey which the men of war had caught, was six hundred thousand and seventy thousand and five thousand sheep,
kjv.31:33: And threescore and twelve thousand beeves,
kjv.31:34: And threescore and one thousand asses,
kjv.31:35: And thirty and two thousand persons in all, of women that had not known man by lying with him.
kjv.31:36: And the half, [which was] the portion of them that went out to war, was in number three hundred thousand and seven and thirty thousand and five hundred sheep:
kjv.31:37: And the LORD'S tribute of the sheep was six hundred and threescore and fifteen.
kjv.31:38: And the beeves [were] thirty and six thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute [was] threescore and twelve.
kjv.31:39: And the asses [were] thirty thousand and five hundred; of which the LORD'S tribute [was] threescore and one.
kjv.31:40: And the persons [were] sixteen thousand; of which the LORD'S tribute [was] thirty and two persons.
kjv.31:41: And Moses gave the tribute, [which was] the LORD'S heave offering, unto Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.
kjv.31:42: And of the children of Israel's half, which Moses divided from the men that warred,
kjv.31:43: (Now the half [that pertained unto] the congregation was three hundred thousand and thirty thousand [and] seven thousand and five hundred sheep,
kjv.31:44: And thirty and six thousand beeves,
kjv.31:45: And thirty thousand asses and five hundred,
kjv.31:47: Even of the children of Israel's half, Moses took one portion of fifty, [both] of man and of beast, and gave them unto the Levites, which kept the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD; as the LORD commanded Moses.
kjv.31:48: And the officers which [were] over thousands of the host, the captains of thousands, and captains of hundreds, came near unto Moses:
kjv.31:49: And they said unto Moses, Thy servants have taken the sum of the men of war which [are] under our charge, and there lacketh not one man of us.
kjv.31:50: We have therefore brought an oblation for the LORD, what every man hath gotten, of jewels of gold, chains, and bracelets, rings, earrings, and tablets, to make an atonement for our souls before the LORD.
kjv.31:51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of them, [even] all wrought jewels.
kjv.31:52: And all the gold of the offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred and fifty shekels.
kjv.31:53: ([For] the men of war had taken spoil, every man for himself.)
kjv.31:54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the tabernacle of the congregation, [for] a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.
kjv.32:1: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of cattle: and when they saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead, that, behold, the place [was] a place for cattle;
kjv.32:2: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spake unto Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and unto the princes of the congregation, saying,
kjv.32:3: Ataroth, and Dibon, and Jazer, and Nimrah, and Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Shebam, and Nebo, and Beon,
kjv.32:4: [Even] the country which the LORD smote before the congregation of Israel, [is] a land for cattle, and thy servants have cattle:
kjv.32:5: Wherefore, said they, if we have found grace in thy sight, let this land be given unto thy servants for a possession, [and] bring us not over Jordan.
kjv.32:6: And Moses said unto the children of Gad and to the children of Reuben, Shall your brethren go to war, and shall ye sit here?
kjv.32:7: And wherefore discourage ye the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD hath given them?
kjv.32:8: Thus did your fathers, when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
kjv.32:9: For when they went up unto the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.
kjv.32:10: And the LORD'S anger was kindled the same time, and he sware, saying,
kjv.32:11: Surely none of the men that came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I sware unto Abraham, unto Isaac, and unto Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me:
kjv.32:12: Save Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenezite, and Joshua the son of Nun: for they have wholly followed the LORD.
kjv.32:13: And the LORD'S anger was kindled against Israel, and he made them wander in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, that had done evil in the sight of the LORD, was consumed.
kjv.32:14: And, behold, ye are risen up in your fathers' stead, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.
kjv.32:15: For if ye turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and ye shall destroy all this people.
kjv.32:16: And they came near unto him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our cattle, and cities for our little ones:
kjv.32:17: But we ourselves will go ready armed before the children of Israel, until we have brought them unto their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fenced cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
kjv.32:18: We will not return unto our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited every man his inheritance.
kjv.32:19: For we will not inherit with them on yonder side Jordan, or forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side Jordan eastward.
kjv.32:20: And Moses said unto them, If ye will do this thing, if ye will go armed before the LORD to war,
kjv.32:21: And will go all of you armed over Jordan before the LORD, until he hath driven out his enemies from before him,
kjv.32:22: And the land be subdued before the LORD: then afterward ye shall return, and be guiltless before the LORD, and before Israel; and this land shall be your possession before the LORD.
kjv.32:23: But if ye will not do so, behold, ye have sinned against the LORD: and be sure your sin will find you out.
kjv.32:24: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which hath proceeded out of your mouth.
kjv.32:25: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben spake unto Moses, saying, Thy servants will do as my lord commandeth.
kjv.32:26: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our cattle, shall be there in the cities of Gilead:
kjv.32:27: But thy servants will pass over, every man armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord saith.
kjv.32:28: So concerning them Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun, and the chief fathers of the tribes of the children of Israel:
kjv.32:29: And Moses said unto them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over Jordan, every man armed to battle, before the LORD, and the land shall be subdued before you; then ye shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
kjv.32:30: But if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.
kjv.32:31: And the children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, As the LORD hath said unto thy servants, so will we do.
kjv.32:32: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, that the possession of our inheritance on this side Jordan [may be] our's.
kjv.32:33: And Moses gave unto them, [even] to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and unto half the tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, with the cities thereof in the coasts, [even] the cities of the country round about.
kjv.32:34: And the children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
kjv.32:35: And Atroth, Shophan, and Jaazer, and Jogbehah,
kjv.32:36: And Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fenced cities: and folds for sheep.
kjv.32:37: And the children of Reuben built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kirjathaim,
kjv.32:38: And Nebo, and Baal-meon, (their names being changed,) and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded.
kjv.32:39: And the children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorite which [was] in it.
kjv.32:40: And Moses gave Gilead unto Machir the son of Manasseh; and he dwelt therein.
kjv.32:41: And Jair the son of Manasseh went and took the small towns thereof, and called them Havoth-jair.
kjv.32:42: And Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages thereof, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
kjv.33:1: These [are] the journeys of the children of Israel, which went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.
kjv.33:2: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of the LORD: and these [are] their journeys according to their goings out.
kjv.33:3: And they departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the morrow after the passover the children of Israel went out with an high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.
kjv.33:4: For the Egyptians buried all [their] firstborn, which the LORD had smitten among them: upon their gods also the LORD executed judgments.
kjv.33:5: And the children of Israel removed from Rameses, and pitched in Succoth.
kjv.33:6: And they departed from Succoth, and pitched in Etham, which [is] in the edge of the wilderness.
kjv.33:7: And they removed from Etham, and turned again unto Pi-hahiroth, which [is] before Baal-zephon: and they pitched before Migdol.
kjv.33:8: And they departed from before Pi-hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.
kjv.33:9: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim [were] twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
kjv.33:10: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
kjv.33:11: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
kjv.33:12: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
kjv.33:13: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
kjv.33:14: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
kjv.33:15: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
kjv.33:16: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.
kjv.33:17: And they departed from Kibroth-hattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
kjv.33:18: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
kjv.33:19: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmon-parez.
kjv.33:20: And they departed from Rimmon-parez, and pitched in Libnah.
kjv.33:21: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
kjv.33:22: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
kjv.33:23: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
kjv.33:24: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
kjv.33:25: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
kjv.33:26: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
kjv.33:27: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
kjv.33:28: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
kjv.33:29: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
kjv.33:30: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
kjv.33:31: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Bene-jaakan.
kjv.33:32: And they removed from Bene-jaakan, and encamped at Hor-hagidgad.
kjv.33:33: And they went from Hor-hagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
kjv.33:34: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
kjv.33:35: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Ezion-gaber.
kjv.33:36: And they removed from Ezion-gaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which [is] Kadesh.
kjv.33:37: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
kjv.33:38: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first [day] of the fifth month.
kjv.33:39: And Aaron [was] an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
kjv.33:40: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
kjv.33:41: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
kjv.33:42: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
kjv.33:43: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
kjv.33:44: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.
kjv.33:45: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibon-gad.
kjv.33:46: And they removed from Dibon-gad, and encamped in Almon-diblathaim.
kjv.33:47: And they removed from Almon-diblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
kjv.33:48: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho.
kjv.33:49: And they pitched by Jordan, from Beth-jesimoth [even] unto Abel-shittim in the plains of Moab.
kjv.33:50: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho, saying,
kjv.33:51: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
kjv.33:52: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
kjv.33:53: And ye shall dispossess [the inhabitants] of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
kjv.33:54: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: [and] to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's [inheritance] shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
kjv.33:55: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them [shall be] pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
kjv.33:56: Moreover it shall come to pass, [that] I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
kjv.34:1: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
kjv.34:2: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this [is] the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, [even] the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
kjv.34:3: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
kjv.34:4: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadesh-barnea, and shall go on to Hazar-addar, and pass on to Azmon:
kjv.34:5: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
kjv.34:6: And [as for] the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
kjv.34:7: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
kjv.34:8: From mount Hor ye shall point out [your border] unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
kjv.34:9: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar-enan: this shall be your north border.
kjv.34:10: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazar-enan to Shepham:
kjv.34:11: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
kjv.34:12: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
kjv.34:13: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This [is] the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
kjv.34:14: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received [their inheritance]; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
kjv.34:15: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan [near] Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
kjv.34:16: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
kjv.34:17: These [are] the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
kjv.34:18: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.
kjv.34:19: And the names of the men [are] these: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
kjv.34:20: And of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.
kjv.34:21: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.
kjv.34:22: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Dan, Bukki the son of Jogli.
kjv.34:23: The prince of the children of Joseph, for the tribe of the children of Manasseh, Hanniel the son of Ephod.
kjv.34:24: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Ephraim, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.
kjv.34:25: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Zebulun, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.
kjv.34:26: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Issachar, Paltiel the son of Azzan.
kjv.34:27: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Asher, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.
kjv.34:28: And the prince of the tribe of the children of Naphtali, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.
kjv.34:29: These [are they] whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance unto the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.
kjv.35:1: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho, saying,
kjv.35:2: Command the children of Israel, that they give unto the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and ye shall give [also] unto the Levites suburbs for the cities round about them.
kjv.35:3: And the cities shall they have to dwell in; and the suburbs of them shall be for their cattle, and for their goods, and for all their beasts.
kjv.35:4: And the suburbs of the cities, which ye shall give unto the Levites, [shall reach] from the wall of the city and outward a thousand cubits round about.
kjv.35:5: And ye shall measure from without the city on the east side two thousand cubits, and on the south side two thousand cubits, and on the west side two thousand cubits, and on the north side two thousand cubits; and the city [shall be] in the midst: this shall be to them the suburbs of the cities.
kjv.35:6: And among the cities which ye shall give unto the Levites [there shall be] six cities for refuge, which ye shall appoint for the manslayer, that he may flee thither: and to them ye shall add forty and two cities.
kjv.35:7: [So] all the cities which ye shall give to the Levites [shall be] forty and eight cities: them [shall ye give] with their suburbs.
kjv.35:8: And the cities which ye shall give [shall be] of the possession of the children of Israel: from [them that have] many ye shall give many; but from [them that have] few ye shall give few: every one shall give of his cities unto the Levites according to his inheritance which he inheriteth.
kjv.35:9: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
kjv.35:10: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye be come over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
kjv.35:11: Then ye shall appoint you cities to be cities of refuge for you; that the slayer may flee thither, which killeth any person at unawares.
kjv.35:12: And they shall be unto you cities for refuge from the avenger; that the manslayer die not, until he stand before the congregation in judgment.
kjv.35:13: And of these cities which ye shall give six cities shall ye have for refuge.
kjv.35:14: Ye shall give three cities on this side Jordan, and three cities shall ye give in the land of Canaan, [which] shall be cities of refuge.
kjv.35:15: These six cities shall be a refuge, [both] for the children of Israel, and for the stranger, and for the sojourner among them: that every one that killeth any person unawares may flee thither.
kjv.35:16: And if he smite him with an instrument of iron, so that he die, he [is] a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
kjv.35:17: And if he smite him with throwing a stone, wherewith he may die, and he die, he [is] a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
kjv.35:18: Or [if] he smite him with an hand weapon of wood, wherewith he may die, and he die, he [is] a murderer: the murderer shall surely be put to death.
kjv.35:19: The revenger of blood himself shall slay the murderer: when he meeteth him, he shall slay him.
kjv.35:20: But if he thrust him of hatred, or hurl at him by laying of wait, that he die;
kjv.35:21: Or in enmity smite him with his hand, that he die: he that smote [him] shall surely be put to death; [for] he [is] a murderer: the revenger of blood shall slay the murderer, when he meeteth him.
kjv.35:22: But if he thrust him suddenly without enmity, or have cast upon him any thing without laying of wait,
kjv.35:23: Or with any stone, wherewith a man may die, seeing [him] not, and cast [it] upon him, that he die, and [was] not his enemy, neither sought his harm:
kjv.35:24: Then the congregation shall judge between the slayer and the revenger of blood according to these judgments:
kjv.35:25: And the congregation shall deliver the slayer out of the hand of the revenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to the city of his refuge, whither he was fled: and he shall abide in it unto the death of the high priest, which was anointed with the holy oil.
kjv.35:26: But if the slayer shall at any time come without the border of the city of his refuge, whither he was fled;
kjv.35:27: And the revenger of blood find him without the borders of the city of his refuge, and the revenger of blood kill the slayer; he shall not be guilty of blood:
kjv.35:28: Because he should have remained in the city of his refuge until the death of the high priest: but after the death of the high priest the slayer shall return into the land of his possession.
kjv.35:29: So these [things] shall be for a statute of judgment unto you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.
kjv.35:30: Whoso killeth any person, the murderer shall be put to death by the mouth of witnesses: but one witness shall not testify against any person [to cause him] to die.
kjv.35:31: Moreover ye shall take no satisfaction for the life of a murderer, which [is] guilty of death: but he shall be surely put to death.
kjv.35:32: And ye shall take no satisfaction for him that is fled to the city of his refuge, that he should come again to dwell in the land, until the death of the priest.
kjv.35:33: So ye shall not pollute the land wherein ye [are]: for blood it defileth the land: and the land cannot be cleansed of the blood that is shed therein, but by the blood of him that shed it.
kjv.35:34: Defile not therefore the land which ye shall inhabit, wherein I dwell: for I the LORD dwell among the children of Israel.
kjv.36:1: And the chief fathers of the families of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near, and spake before Moses, and before the princes, the chief fathers of the children of Israel:
kjv.36:2: And they said, The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for an inheritance by lot to the children of Israel: and my lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother unto his daughters.
kjv.36:3: And if they be married to any of the sons of the [other] tribes of the children of Israel, then shall their inheritance be taken from the inheritance of our fathers, and shall be put to the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall it be taken from the lot of our inheritance.
kjv.36:4: And when the jubile of the children of Israel shall be, then shall their inheritance be put unto the inheritance of the tribe whereunto they are received: so shall their inheritance be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.
kjv.36:5: And Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the word of the LORD, saying, The tribe of the sons of Joseph hath said well.
kjv.36:6: This [is] the thing which the LORD doth command concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, Let them marry to whom they think best; only to the family of the tribe of their father shall they marry.
kjv.36:7: So shall not the inheritance of the children of Israel remove from tribe to tribe: for every one of the children of Israel shall keep himself to the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.
kjv.36:8: And every daughter, that possesseth an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel, shall be wife unto one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may enjoy every man the inheritance of his fathers.
kjv.36:9: Neither shall the inheritance remove from [one] tribe to another tribe; but every one of the tribes of the children of Israel shall keep himself to his own inheritance.
kjv.36:10: Even as the LORD commanded Moses, so did the daughters of Zelophehad:
kjv.36:11: For Mahlah, Tirzah, and Hoglah, and Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married unto their father's brothers' sons:
kjv.36:12: [And] they were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph, and their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.
kjv.36:13: These [are] the commandments and the judgments, which the LORD commanded by the hand of Moses unto the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho.

bsb.1:1: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai. He said:
bsb.1:2: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
bsb.1:3: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions—everyone who can serve in Israel’s army.
bsb.1:4: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you.
bsb.1:5: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
bsb.1:6: from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
bsb.1:7: from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
bsb.1:8: from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
bsb.1:9: from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
bsb.1:10: from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
bsb.1:11: from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
bsb.1:12: from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
bsb.1:13: from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran;
bsb.1:14: from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
bsb.1:15: and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
bsb.1:16: These men were appointed from the congregation; they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the clans of Israel.
bsb.1:17: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,
bsb.1:18: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families, counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age or older,
bsb.1:19: just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai:
bsb.1:20: From the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:21: those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500.
bsb.1:22: From the sons of Simeon, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:23: those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300.
bsb.1:24: From the sons of Gad, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:25: those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650.
bsb.1:26: From the sons of Judah, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:27: those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600.
bsb.1:28: From the sons of Issachar, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:29: those registered to the tribe of Issachar numbered 54,400.
bsb.1:30: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:31: those registered to the tribe of Zebulun numbered 57,400.
bsb.1:33: From the sons of Ephraim, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Ephraim numbered 40,500.
bsb.1:34: And from the sons of Manasseh, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:35: those registered to the tribe of Manasseh numbered 32,200.
bsb.1:36: From the sons of Benjamin, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:37: those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400.
bsb.1:38: From the sons of Dan, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:39: those registered to the tribe of Dan numbered 62,700.
bsb.1:40: From the sons of Asher, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:41: those registered to the tribe of Asher numbered 41,500.
bsb.1:42: From the sons of Naphtali, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army,
bsb.1:43: those registered to the tribe of Naphtali numbered 53,400.
bsb.1:44: These were the men numbered by Moses and Aaron, with the assistance of the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
bsb.1:45: So all the Israelites twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
bsb.1:47: The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
bsb.1:48: For the LORD had said to Moses:
bsb.1:49: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
bsb.1:50: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
bsb.1:51: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
bsb.1:52: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.
bsb.1:53: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
bsb.1:54: Thus the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.2:1: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron:
bsb.2:2: “The Israelites are to camp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it, each man under his standard, with the banners of his family.
bsb.2:3: On the east side, toward the sunrise, the divisions of Judah are to camp under their standard:
bsb.2:4: The leader of the descendants of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab, and his division numbers 74,600.
bsb.2:5: The tribe of Issachar will camp next to it. The leader of the Issacharites is Nethanel son of Zuar,
bsb.2:7: Next will be the tribe of Zebulun. The leader of the Zebulunites is Eliab son of Helon,
bsb.2:9: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Judah is 186,400; they shall set out first.
bsb.2:10: On the south side, the divisions of Reuben are to camp under their standard:
bsb.2:11: The leader of the Reubenites is Elizur son of Shedeur, and his division numbers 46,500.
bsb.2:12: The tribe of Simeon will camp next to it. The leader of the Simeonites is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
bsb.2:14: Next will be the tribe of Gad. The leader of the Gadites is Eliasaph son of Deuel,
bsb.2:16: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Reuben is 151,450; they shall set out second.
bsb.2:17: In the middle of the camps, the Tent of Meeting is to travel with the camp of the Levites. They are to set out in the order they encamped, each in his own place under his standard.
bsb.2:18: On the west side, the divisions of Ephraim are to camp under their standard:
bsb.2:19: The leader of the Ephraimites is Elishama son of Ammihud, and his division numbers 40,500.
bsb.2:20: The tribe of Manasseh will be next to it. The leader of the Manassites is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
bsb.2:22: Next will be the tribe of Benjamin. The leader of the Benjamites is Abidan son of Gideoni,
bsb.2:24: The total number of men in the divisions of the camp of Ephraim is 108,100; they shall set out third.
bsb.2:25: On the north side, the divisions of Dan are to camp under their standard:
bsb.2:26: The leader of the Danites is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai, and his division numbers 62,700.
bsb.2:27: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,
bsb.2:29: Next will be the tribe of Naphtali. The leader of the Naphtalites is Ahira son of Enan,
bsb.2:31: The total number of men in the camp of Dan is 157,600; they shall set out last, under their standards.”
bsb.2:32: These are the Israelites, numbered according to their families. The total of those counted in the camps, by their divisions, was 603,550.
bsb.2:33: But the Levites were not counted among the other Israelites, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.2:34: So the Israelites did everything the LORD commanded Moses; they camped under their standards in this way and set out in the same way, each man with his clan and his family.
bsb.3:1: This is the account of Aaron and Moses at the time the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
bsb.3:2: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, then Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
bsb.3:3: These were Aaron’s sons, the anointed priests, who were ordained to serve as priests.
bsb.3:4: Nadab and Abihu, however, died in the presence of the LORD when they offered unauthorized fire before the LORD in the Wilderness of Sinai. And since they had no sons, only Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests during the lifetime of their father Aaron.
bsb.3:5: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.3:6: “Bring the tribe of Levi and present them to Aaron the priest to assist him.
bsb.3:7: They are to perform duties for him and for the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, attending to the service of the tabernacle.
bsb.3:8: They shall take care of all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting and fulfill obligations for the Israelites by attending to the service of the tabernacle.
bsb.3:9: Assign the Levites to Aaron and his sons; they have been given exclusively to him from among the Israelites.
bsb.3:10: So you shall appoint Aaron and his sons to carry out the duties of the priesthood; but any outsider who approaches the tabernacle must be put to death.”
bsb.3:11: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
bsb.3:12: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel in place of every firstborn Israelite from the womb. The Levites belong to Me,
bsb.3:13: for all the firstborn are Mine. On the day I struck down every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself all the firstborn in Israel, both man and beast. They are Mine; I am the LORD.”
bsb.3:14: Then the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai, saying,
bsb.3:15: “Number the Levites by their families and clans. You are to count every male a month old or more.”
bsb.3:16: So Moses numbered them according to the word of the LORD, as he had been commanded.
bsb.3:17: These were the sons of Levi by name: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
bsb.3:18: These were the names of the sons of Gershon by their clans: Libni and Shimei.
bsb.3:19: The sons of Kohath by their clans were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.
bsb.3:20: And the sons of Merari by their clans were Mahli and Mushi. These were the clans of the Levites, according to their families.
bsb.3:21: From Gershon came the Libnite clan and the Shimeite clan; these were the Gershonite clans.
bsb.3:22: The number of all the males a month old or more was 7,500.
bsb.3:23: The Gershonite clans were to camp on the west, behind the tabernacle,
bsb.3:24: and the leader of the families of the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
bsb.3:25: The duties of the Gershonites at the Tent of Meeting were the tabernacle and tent, its covering, the curtain for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
bsb.3:26: the curtains of the courtyard, the curtain for the entrance to the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, and the cords—all the service for these items.
bsb.3:27: From Kohath came the clans of the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites; these were the clans of the Kohathites.
bsb.3:28: The number of all the males a month old or more was 8,600. They were responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
bsb.3:29: The clans of the Kohathites were to camp on the south side of the tabernacle,
bsb.3:30: and the leader of the families of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
bsb.3:31: Their duties were the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, the articles of the sanctuary used with them, and the curtain—all the service for these items.
bsb.3:32: The chief of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest; he oversaw those responsible for the duties of the sanctuary.
bsb.3:33: From Merari came the clans of the Mahlites and Mushites; these were the Merarite clans.
bsb.3:34: The number of all the males a month old or more was 6,200.
bsb.3:35: The leader of the families of the Merarites was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to camp on the north side of the tabernacle.
bsb.3:36: The duties assigned to the sons of Merari were the tabernacle’s frames, crossbars, posts, bases, and all its equipment—all the service for these items,
bsb.3:37: as well as the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes.
bsb.3:38: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons were to camp to the east of the tabernacle, toward the sunrise, before the Tent of Meeting. They were to perform the duties of the sanctuary as a service on behalf of the Israelites; but any outsider who approached the sanctuary was to be put to death.
bsb.3:39: The total number of Levites that Moses and Aaron counted by their clans at the LORD’s command, including all the males a month old or more, was 22,000.
bsb.3:40: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Number every firstborn male of the Israelites a month old or more, and list their names.
bsb.3:41: You are to take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the livestock of the Israelites.”
bsb.3:42: So Moses numbered all the firstborn of the Israelites, as the LORD had commanded him.
bsb.3:43: The total number of the firstborn males a month old or more, listed by name, was 22,273.
bsb.3:44: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
bsb.3:45: “Take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock. The Levites belong to Me; I am the LORD.
bsb.3:46: To redeem the 273 firstborn Israelites who outnumber the Levites,
bsb.3:47: you are to collect five shekels for each one, according to the sanctuary shekel of twenty gerahs.
bsb.3:48: Give the money to Aaron and his sons as the redemption price for the excess among the Israelites.”
bsb.3:49: So Moses collected the redemption money from those in excess of the number redeemed by the Levites.
bsb.3:50: He collected the money from the firstborn of the Israelites: 1,365 shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
bsb.3:51: And Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and his sons in obedience to the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded him.
bsb.4:1: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
bsb.4:2: “Take a census of the Kohathites among the Levites by their clans and families,
bsb.4:3: men from thirty to fifty years old—everyone who is qualified to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:4: This service of the Kohathites at the Tent of Meeting regards the most holy things.
bsb.4:5: Whenever the camp sets out, Aaron and his sons are to go in, take down the veil of the curtain, and cover the ark of the Testimony with it.
bsb.4:6: They are to place over this a covering of fine leather, spread a solid blue cloth over it, and insert its poles.
bsb.4:7: Over the table of the Presence they are to spread a blue cloth and place the plates and cups on it, along with the bowls and pitchers for the drink offering. The regular bread offering is to remain on it.
bsb.4:8: And they shall spread a scarlet cloth over them, cover them with fine leather, and insert the poles.
bsb.4:9: They are to take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand used for light, together with its lamps, wick trimmers, and trays, as well as the jars of oil with which to supply it.
bsb.4:10: Then they shall wrap it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and put it on the carrying frame.
bsb.4:11: Over the gold altar they are to spread a blue cloth, cover it with fine leather, and insert the poles.
bsb.4:12: They are to take all the utensils for serving in the sanctuary, place them in a blue cloth, cover them with fine leather, and put them on the carrying frame.
bsb.4:13: Then they shall remove the ashes from the bronze altar, spread a purple cloth over it,
bsb.4:14: and place on it all the vessels used to serve there: the firepans, meat forks, shovels, and sprinkling bowls—all the equipment of the altar. They are to spread over it a covering of fine leather and insert the poles.
bsb.4:15: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the holy objects and all their equipment, as soon as the camp is ready to move, the Kohathites shall come and do the carrying. But they must not touch the holy objects, or they will die. These are the transportation duties of the Kohathites regarding the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:16: Eleazar son of Aaron the priest shall oversee the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the daily grain offering, and the anointing oil. He has oversight of the entire tabernacle and everything in it, including the holy objects and their utensils.”
bsb.4:17: Then the LORD said to Moses and Aaron,
bsb.4:18: “Do not allow the Kohathite tribal clans to be cut off from among the Levites.
bsb.4:19: In order that they may live and not die when they come near the most holy things, do this for them: Aaron and his sons are to go in and assign each man his task and what he is to carry.
bsb.4:20: But the Kohathites are not to go in and look at the holy objects, even for a moment, or they will die.”
bsb.4:21: And the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.4:22: “Take a census of the Gershonites as well, by their families and clans,
bsb.4:23: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:24: This is the service of the Gershonite clans regarding work and transport:
bsb.4:25: They are to carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the Tent of Meeting with the covering of fine leather over it, the curtains for the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
bsb.4:26: the curtains of the courtyard, and the curtains for the entrance at the gate of the courtyard that surrounds the tabernacle and altar, along with their ropes and all the equipment for their service. The Gershonites will do all that needs to be done with these items.
bsb.4:27: All the service of the Gershonites—all their transport duties and other work—is to be done at the direction of Aaron and his sons; you are to assign to them all that they are responsible to carry.
bsb.4:28: This is the service of the Gershonite clans at the Tent of Meeting, and their duties shall be under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
bsb.4:29: As for the sons of Merari, you are to number them by their clans and families,
bsb.4:30: from thirty to fifty years old, counting everyone who comes to serve in the work of the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:31: This is the duty for all their service at the Tent of Meeting: to carry the frames of the tabernacle with its crossbars, posts, and bases,
bsb.4:32: and the posts of the surrounding courtyard with their bases, tent pegs, and ropes, including all their equipment and everything related to their use. You shall assign by name the items that they are responsible to carry.
bsb.4:33: This is the service of the Merarite clans according to all their work at the Tent of Meeting, under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.”
bsb.4:34: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation numbered the Kohathites by their clans and families,
bsb.4:35: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:36: And those numbered by their clans totaled 2,750.
bsb.4:37: These were counted from the Kohathite clans, everyone who could serve at the Tent of Meeting. Moses and Aaron numbered them according to the command of the LORD through Moses.
bsb.4:38: Then the Gershonites were numbered by their clans and families,
bsb.4:39: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:40: And those numbered by their clans and families totaled 2,630.
bsb.4:41: These were counted from the Gershonite clans who served at the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the LORD’s command.
bsb.4:42: And the Merarites were numbered by their clans and families,
bsb.4:43: everyone from thirty to fifty years old who came to serve in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:44: The men registered by their clans numbered 3,200.
bsb.4:45: These were counted from the Merarite clans, whom Moses and Aaron numbered at the LORD’s command through Moses.
bsb.4:46: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel numbered by their clans and families all the Levites
bsb.4:47: from thirty to fifty years old who came to do the work of serving and carrying the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.4:48: And the number of men was 8,580.
bsb.4:49: At the LORD’s command they were numbered through Moses and each one was assigned his work and burden, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.5:1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.5:2: “Command the Israelites to send away from the camp anyone with a skin disease, anyone who has a bodily discharge, and anyone who is defiled by a dead body.
bsb.5:3: You must send away male and female alike; send them outside the camp so they will not defile their camp, where I dwell among them.”
bsb.5:4: So the Israelites did this, sending such people outside the camp. They did just as the LORD had instructed Moses.
bsb.5:5: And the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.5:6: “Tell the Israelites that when a man or woman acts unfaithfully against the LORD by committing any sin against another, that person is guilty
bsb.5:7: and must confess the sin he has committed. He must make full restitution, add a fifth to its value, and give all this to the one he has wronged.
bsb.5:8: But if the man has no relative to whom restitution can be made for the wrong, the restitution belongs to the LORD and must be given to the priest along with the ram of atonement, by which the atonement is made for him.
bsb.5:9: Every sacred contribution the Israelites bring to the priest shall belong to him.
bsb.5:10: Each man’s sacred gifts are his own, but whatever he gives to the priest will belong to the priest.”
bsb.5:11: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.5:12: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him
bsb.5:13: by sleeping with another man, and it is concealed from her husband and her impurity is undetected (since there is no witness against her and she was not caught in the act),
bsb.5:14: and if a feeling of jealousy comes over her husband and he suspects his wife who has defiled herself—or if a feeling of jealousy comes over him and he suspects her even though she has not defiled herself—
bsb.5:15: then he is to bring his wife to the priest. He must also bring for her an offering of a tenth of an ephah of barley flour. He is not to pour oil over it or put frankincense on it, because it is a grain offering for jealousy, an offering of memorial as a reminder of iniquity.
bsb.5:16: The priest is to bring the wife forward and have her stand before the LORD.
bsb.5:17: Then he is to take some holy water in a clay jar and put some of the dust from the tabernacle floor into the water.
bsb.5:18: After the priest has the woman stand before the LORD, he is to let down her hair and place in her hands the grain offering of memorial, which is the grain offering for jealousy. The priest is to hold the bitter water that brings a curse.
bsb.5:19: And he is to put the woman under oath and say to her, ‘If no other man has slept with you and you have not gone astray and become defiled while under your husband’s authority, may you be immune to this bitter water that brings a curse.
bsb.5:20: But if you have gone astray while under your husband’s authority and have defiled yourself and lain carnally with a man other than your husband’—
bsb.5:21: and the priest shall have the woman swear under the oath of the curse—‘then may the LORD make you an attested curse among your people by making your thigh shrivel and your belly swell.
bsb.5:22: May this water that brings a curse enter your stomach and cause your belly to swell and your thigh to shrivel.’ Then the woman is to say, ‘Amen, Amen.’
bsb.5:23: And the priest shall write these curses on a scroll and wash them off into the bitter water.
bsb.5:24: He is to have the woman drink the bitter water that brings a curse, and it will enter her and cause her bitter suffering.
bsb.5:25: The priest shall take from her hand the grain offering for jealousy, wave it before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.
bsb.5:26: Then the priest is to take a handful of the grain offering as a memorial portion and burn it on the altar; after that he is to have the woman drink the water.
bsb.5:27: When he has made her drink the water, if she has defiled herself and been unfaithful to her husband, then the water that brings a curse will enter her and cause bitter suffering; her belly will swell, her thigh will shrivel, and she will become accursed among her people.
bsb.5:28: But if the woman has not defiled herself and is clean, she will be unaffected and able to conceive children.
bsb.5:29: This is the law of jealousy when a wife goes astray and defiles herself while under her husband’s authority,
bsb.5:30: or when a feeling of jealousy comes over a husband and he suspects his wife. He is to have the woman stand before the LORD, and the priest is to apply to her this entire law.
bsb.5:31: The husband will be free from guilt, but the woman shall bear her iniquity.”
bsb.6:1: And the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.6:2: “Speak to the Israelites and tell them that if a man or woman makes a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,
bsb.6:3: he is to abstain from wine and strong drink. He must not drink vinegar made from wine or strong drink, and he must not drink any grape juice or eat fresh grapes or raisins.
bsb.6:4: All the days of his separation, he is not to eat anything that comes from the grapevine, not even the seeds or skins.
bsb.6:5: For the entire period of his vow of separation, no razor shall pass over his head. He must be holy until the time of his separation to the LORD is complete; he must let the hair of his head grow long.
bsb.6:6: Throughout the days of his separation to the LORD, he must not go near a dead body.
bsb.6:7: Even if his father or mother or brother or sister should die, he is not to defile himself, because the crown of consecration to his God is upon his head.
bsb.6:8: Throughout the time of his separation, he is holy to the LORD.
bsb.6:9: If someone suddenly dies in his presence and defiles his consecrated head of hair, he must shave his head on the day of his cleansing—the seventh day.
bsb.6:10: On the eighth day he must bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.6:11: And the priest is to offer one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to make atonement for him, because he has sinned by being in the presence of the dead body. On that day he must consecrate his head again.
bsb.6:12: He must rededicate his time of separation to the LORD and bring a year-old male lamb as a guilt offering. But the preceding days shall not be counted, because his separation was defiled.
bsb.6:13: Now this is the law of the Nazirite when his time of separation is complete: He must be brought to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting,
bsb.6:14: and he is to present an offering to the LORD of an unblemished year-old male lamb as a burnt offering, an unblemished year-old female lamb as a sin offering, and an unblemished ram as a peace offering—
bsb.6:15: together with their grain offerings and drink offerings—and a basket of unleavened cakes made from fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers coated with oil.
bsb.6:16: The priest is to present all these before the LORD and make the sin offering and the burnt offering.
bsb.6:17: He shall also offer the ram as a peace offering to the LORD, along with the basket of unleavened bread. And the priest is to offer the accompanying grain offering and drink offering.
bsb.6:18: Then at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting, the Nazirite is to shave his consecrated head, take the hair, and put it on the fire under the peace offering.
bsb.6:19: And the priest is to take the boiled shoulder from the ram, one unleavened cake from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and put them into the hands of the Nazirite who has just shaved the hair of his consecration.
bsb.6:20: The priest shall then wave them as a wave offering before the LORD. This is a holy portion for the priest, in addition to the breast of the wave offering and the thigh that was presented. After that, the Nazirite may drink wine.
bsb.6:21: This is the law of the Nazirite who vows his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to whatever else he can afford; he must fulfill whatever vow he makes, according to the law of his separation.”
bsb.6:22: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.6:23: “Tell Aaron and his sons: This is how you are to bless the Israelites. Say to them:
bsb.6:24: ‘May the LORD bless you and keep you;
bsb.6:25: may the LORD cause His face to shine upon you and be gracious to you;
bsb.6:26: may the LORD lift up His countenance toward you and give you peace.’
bsb.6:27: So they shall put My name on the Israelites, and I will bless them.”
bsb.7:1: On the day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed and consecrated it and all its furnishings, along with the altar and all its utensils.
bsb.7:2: And the leaders of Israel, the heads of their families, presented an offering. These men were the tribal leaders who had supervised the registration.
bsb.7:3: They brought as their offering before the LORD six covered carts and twelve oxen—an ox from each leader and a cart from every two leaders—and presented them before the tabernacle.
bsb.7:4: And the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.7:5: “Accept these gifts from them, that they may be used in the work of the Tent of Meeting. And give them to the Levites, to each man according to his service.”
bsb.7:6: So Moses took the carts and oxen and gave them to the Levites.
bsb.7:7: He gave the Gershonites two carts and four oxen, as their service required,
bsb.7:8: and he gave the Merarites four carts and eight oxen, as their service required, all under the direction of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.
bsb.7:9: But he did not give any to the Kohathites, since they were to carry on their shoulders the holy objects for which they were responsible.
bsb.7:10: When the altar was anointed, the leaders approached with their offerings for its dedication and presented them before the altar.
bsb.7:11: And the LORD said to Moses, “Each day one leader is to present his offering for the dedication of the altar.”
bsb.7:12: On the first day Nahshon son of Amminadab from the tribe of Judah drew near with his offering.
bsb.7:13: His offering was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
bsb.7:14: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
bsb.7:15: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
bsb.7:16: one male goat for a sin offering;
bsb.7:17: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon son of Amminadab.
bsb.7:18: On the second day Nethanel son of Zuar, the leader of Issachar, drew near.
bsb.7:19: The offering he presented was one silver platter weighing a hundred and thirty shekels, and one silver bowl weighing seventy shekels, both according to the sanctuary shekel and filled with fine flour mixed with oil for a grain offering;
bsb.7:20: one gold dish weighing ten shekels, filled with incense;
bsb.7:21: one young bull, one ram, and one male lamb a year old for a burnt offering;
bsb.7:22: one male goat for a sin offering;
bsb.7:23: and a peace offering of two oxen, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel son of Zuar.
bsb.7:24: On the third day Eliab son of Helon, the leader of the Zebulunites, drew near.

bsb.7:84: So these were the offerings from the leaders of Israel for the dedication of the altar when it was anointed: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, and twelve gold dishes.
bsb.7:85: Each silver platter weighed a hundred and thirty shekels, and each silver bowl seventy shekels. The total weight of the silver articles was two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel.
bsb.7:86: The twelve gold dishes filled with incense weighed ten shekels each, according to the sanctuary shekel. The total weight of the gold dishes was a hundred and twenty shekels.
bsb.7:87: All the livestock for the burnt offering totaled twelve bulls, twelve rams, and twelve male lambs a year old—together with their grain offerings—and twelve male goats for the sin offering.
bsb.7:88: All the livestock sacrificed for the peace offering totaled twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering for the altar after it was anointed.
bsb.7:89: When Moses entered the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard the voice speaking to him from between the two cherubim above the mercy seat on the ark of the Testimony. Thus the LORD spoke to him.
bsb.8:1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.8:2: “Speak to Aaron and tell him: ‘When you set up the seven lamps, they are to light the area in front of the lampstand.’”
bsb.8:3: And Aaron did so; he set up the lamps facing toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.8:4: This is how the lampstand was constructed: it was made of hammered gold from its base to its blossoms, fashioned according to the pattern the LORD had shown Moses.
bsb.8:5: Again the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
bsb.8:6: “Take the Levites from among the Israelites and make them ceremonially clean.
bsb.8:7: This is what you must do to cleanse them: Sprinkle them with the water of purification. Have them shave their whole bodies and wash their clothes, and so purify themselves.
bsb.8:8: Then have them take a young bull with its grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, and you are to take a second young bull for a sin offering.
bsb.8:9: Bring the Levites before the Tent of Meeting and assemble the whole congregation of Israel.
bsb.8:10: You are to present the Levites before the LORD and have the Israelites lay their hands upon them.
bsb.8:11: Aaron is to present the Levites before the LORD as a wave offering from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
bsb.8:12: And the Levites are to lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and offer to the LORD one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering, to make atonement for the Levites.
bsb.8:13: You are to have the Levites stand before Aaron and his sons and then present them before the LORD as a wave offering.
bsb.8:14: In this way you shall separate the Levites from the rest of the Israelites, and the Levites will belong to Me.
bsb.8:15: After you have cleansed them and presented them as a wave offering, they may come to serve at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.8:16: For the Levites have been wholly given to Me from among the sons of Israel. I have taken them for Myself in place of all who come first from the womb, the firstborn of all the sons of Israel.
bsb.8:17: For every firstborn male in Israel is Mine, both man and beast. I set them apart for Myself on the day I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt.
bsb.8:18: But I have taken the Levites in place of all the firstborn among the sons of Israel.
bsb.8:19: And I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and his sons from among the Israelites, to perform the service for the Israelites at the Tent of Meeting and to make atonement on their behalf, so that no plague will come against the Israelites when they approach the sanctuary.”
bsb.8:20: So Moses, Aaron, and the whole congregation of Israel did with the Levites everything that the LORD had commanded Moses they should do.
bsb.8:21: The Levites purified themselves and washed their clothes, and Aaron presented them as a wave offering before the LORD. Aaron also made atonement for them to cleanse them.
bsb.8:22: After that, the Levites came to perform their service at the Tent of Meeting in the presence of Aaron and his sons. Thus they did with the Levites just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.8:23: And the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.8:24: “This applies to the Levites: Men twenty-five years of age or older shall enter to perform the service in the work at the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.8:25: But at the age of fifty, they must retire from performing the work and no longer serve.
bsb.8:26: After that, they may assist their brothers in fulfilling their duties at the Tent of Meeting, but they themselves are not to do the work. This is how you are to assign responsibilities to the Levites.”
bsb.9:1: In the first month of the second year after Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai:
bsb.9:2: “The Israelites are to observe the Passover at its appointed time.
bsb.9:3: You are to observe it at the appointed time, at twilight on the fourteenth day of this month, in accordance with its statutes and ordinances.”
bsb.9:4: So Moses told the Israelites to observe the Passover,
bsb.9:5: and they did so in the Wilderness of Sinai, at twilight on the fourteenth day of the first month. The Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
bsb.9:6: But there were some men who were unclean due to a dead body, so they could not observe the Passover on that day. And they came before Moses and Aaron that same day
bsb.9:7: and said to Moses, “We are unclean because of a dead body, but why should we be excluded from presenting the LORD’s offering with the other Israelites at the appointed time?”
bsb.9:8: “Wait here until I find out what the LORD commands concerning you,” Moses replied.
bsb.9:9: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.9:10: “Tell the Israelites: ‘When any one of you or your descendants is unclean because of a dead body, or is away on a journey, he may still observe the Passover to the LORD.
bsb.9:11: Such people are to observe it at twilight on the fourteenth day of the second month. They are to eat the lamb, together with unleavened bread and bitter herbs;
bsb.9:12: they may not leave any of it until morning or break any of its bones. They must observe the Passover according to all its statutes.
bsb.9:13: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
bsb.9:14: If a foreigner dwelling among you wants to observe the Passover to the LORD, he is to do so according to the Passover statute and its ordinances. You are to apply the same statute to both the foreigner and the native of the land.’”
bsb.9:15: On the day that the tabernacle, the Tent of the Testimony, was set up, the cloud covered it and appeared like fire above the tabernacle from evening until morning.
bsb.9:16: It remained that way continually; the cloud would cover the tabernacle by day, and at night it would appear like fire.
bsb.9:17: Whenever the cloud was lifted from above the Tent, the Israelites would set out, and wherever the cloud settled, there the Israelites would camp.
bsb.9:18: At the LORD’s command the Israelites set out, and at the LORD’s command they camped. As long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle, they remained encamped.
bsb.9:19: Even when the cloud lingered over the tabernacle for many days, the Israelites kept the LORD’s charge and did not set out.
bsb.9:20: Sometimes the cloud remained over the tabernacle for only a few days, and they would camp at the LORD’s command and set out at the LORD’s command.
bsb.9:21: Sometimes the cloud remained only from evening until morning, and when it lifted in the morning, they would set out. Whether it was by day or by night, when the cloud was taken up, they would set out.
bsb.9:22: Whether the cloud lingered for two days, a month, or longer, the Israelites camped and did not set out as long as the cloud remained over the tabernacle; but when it was lifted, they would set out.
bsb.9:23: They camped at the LORD’s command, and they set out at the LORD’s command; they carried out the LORD’s charge according to His command through Moses.
bsb.10:1: Then the LORD said to Moses,
bsb.10:2: “Make two trumpets of hammered silver to be used for calling the congregation and for having the camps set out.
bsb.10:3: When both are sounded, the whole congregation is to assemble before you at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.
bsb.10:4: But if only one is sounded, then the leaders, the heads of the clans of Israel, are to gather before you.
bsb.10:5: When you sound short blasts, the camps that lie on the east side are to set out.
bsb.10:6: When you sound the short blasts a second time, the camps that lie on the south side are to set out. The blasts are to signal them to set out.
bsb.10:7: To convene the assembly, you are to sound long blasts, not short ones.
bsb.10:8: The sons of Aaron, the priests, are to sound the trumpets. This shall be a permanent statute for you and the generations to come.
bsb.10:9: When you enter into battle in your land against an adversary who attacks you, sound short blasts on the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.
bsb.10:10: And on your joyous occasions, your appointed feasts, and the beginning of each month, you are to blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and fellowship offerings to serve as a reminder for you before your God. I am the LORD your God.”
bsb.10:11: On the twentieth day of the second month of the second year, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the Testimony,
bsb.10:12: and the Israelites set out from the Wilderness of Sinai, traveling from place to place until the cloud settled in the Wilderness of Paran.
bsb.10:13: They set out this first time according to the LORD’s command through Moses.
bsb.10:14: First, the divisions of the camp of Judah set out under their standard, with Nahshon son of Amminadab in command.
bsb.10:15: Nethanel son of Zuar was over the division of the tribe of Issachar,
bsb.10:16: and Eliab son of Helon was over the division of the tribe of Zebulun.
bsb.10:17: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the Gershonites and the Merarites set out, transporting it.
bsb.10:18: Then the divisions of the camp of Reuben set out under their standard, with Elizur son of Shedeur in command.
bsb.10:19: Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai was over the division of the tribe of Simeon,
bsb.10:20: and Eliasaph son of Deuel was over the division of the tribe of Gad.
bsb.10:21: Then the Kohathites set out, transporting the holy objects; the tabernacle was to be set up before their arrival.
bsb.10:22: Next, the divisions of the camp of Ephraim set out under their standard, with Elishama son of Ammihud in command.
bsb.10:23: Gamaliel son of Pedahzur was over the division of the tribe of Manasseh,
bsb.10:24: and Abidan son of Gideoni was over the division of the tribe of Benjamin.
bsb.10:25: Finally, the divisions of the camp of Dan set out under their standard, serving as the rear guard for all units, with Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai in command.
bsb.10:26: Pagiel son of Ocran was over the division of the tribe of Asher,
bsb.10:27: and Ahira son of Enan was over the division of the tribe of Naphtali.
bsb.10:28: This was the order of march for the Israelite divisions as they set out.
bsb.10:29: Then Moses said to Hobab, the son of Moses’ father-in-law Reuel the Midianite, “We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said: ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well, for the LORD has promised good things to Israel.”
bsb.10:30: “I will not go,” Hobab replied. “Instead, I am going back to my own land and my own people.”
bsb.10:31: “Please do not leave us,” Moses said, “since you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you can serve as our eyes.
bsb.10:32: If you come with us, we will share with you whatever good things the LORD gives us.”
bsb.10:33: So they set out on a three-day journey from the mountain of the LORD, with the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveling ahead of them for those three days to seek a resting place for them.
bsb.10:34: And the cloud of the LORD was over them by day when they set out from the camp.
bsb.10:35: Whenever the ark set out, Moses would say, “Rise up, O LORD! May Your enemies be scattered; may those who hate You flee before You.”
bsb.10:36: And when it came to rest, he would say: “Return, O LORD, to the countless thousands of Israel.”
bsb.11:1: Soon the people began to complain about their hardship in the hearing of the LORD, and when He heard them, His anger was kindled, and fire from the LORD blazed among them and consumed the outskirts of the camp.
bsb.11:2: And the people cried out to Moses, and he prayed to the LORD, and the fire died down.
bsb.11:3: So that place was called Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
bsb.11:4: Meanwhile, the rabble among them had a strong craving for other food, and again the Israelites wept and said, “Who will feed us meat?
bsb.11:5: We remember the fish we ate freely in Egypt, along with the cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, and garlic.
bsb.11:6: But now our appetite is gone; there is nothing to see but this manna!”
bsb.11:7: Now the manna resembled coriander seed, and its appearance was like that of gum resin.
bsb.11:8: The people walked around and gathered it, ground it on a handmill or crushed it in a mortar, then boiled it in a cooking pot or shaped it into cakes. It tasted like pastry baked with fine oil.
bsb.11:9: When the dew fell on the camp at night, the manna would fall with it.
bsb.11:10: Then Moses heard the people of family after family weeping at the entrances to their tents, and the anger of the LORD was kindled greatly, and Moses was also displeased.
bsb.11:11: So Moses asked the LORD, “Why have You brought this trouble on Your servant? Why have I not found favor in Your sight, that You have laid upon me the burden of all these people?
bsb.11:12: Did I conceive all these people? Did I give them birth, so that You should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries an infant,’ to the land that You swore to give their fathers?
bsb.11:13: Where can I get meat for all these people? For they keep crying out to me, ‘Give us meat to eat!’
bsb.11:14: I cannot carry all these people by myself; it is too burdensome for me.
bsb.11:15: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me right now—if I have found favor in Your eyes—and let me not see my own wretchedness.”
bsb.11:16: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Bring Me seventy of the elders of Israel known to you as leaders and officers of the people. Bring them to the Tent of Meeting and have them stand there with you.
bsb.11:17: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put that Spirit on them. They will help you bear the burden of the people, so that you do not have to bear it by yourself.
bsb.11:18: And say to the people: Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you will eat meat, because you have cried out in the hearing of the LORD, saying: ‘Who will feed us meat? For we were better off in Egypt!’ Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.
bsb.11:19: You will eat it not for one or two days, nor for five or ten or twenty days,
bsb.11:20: but for a whole month—until it comes out of your nostrils and makes you nauseous—because you have rejected the LORD, who is among you, and have cried out before Him, saying, ‘Why did we ever leave Egypt?’”
bsb.11:21: But Moses replied, “Here I am among 600,000 men on foot, yet You say, ‘I will give them meat, and they will eat for a month.’
bsb.11:22: If all our flocks and herds were slaughtered for them, would they have enough? Or if all the fish in the sea were caught for them, would they have enough?”
bsb.11:23: The LORD answered Moses, “Is the LORD’s arm too short? Now you will see whether or not My word will come to pass.”
